description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dream's Grip without paying its mana cost, targeting Isochron Scepter.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Dream's Grip, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Dream's Grips, untapping Isochron Scepter and Basalt Monolith.
Repeat.
